articles.title: Agentic Future Ready With BigQuery Continually Improving Price-Performance, Zero Effort
articles.summary: Google Cloud announces improvements to BigQuery for better price-performance and zero effort.

articles.title: Advancing brain tumor research with privacy-first AI

articles.summary: Google Cloud offers free training on building and scaling agents with expert guidance.
articles.detail: This opportunity provides hands-on experience designing systems for agent interactions and security guardrails.

articles.summary: Google Cloud highlights the importance of digital sovereignty for enterprises and governments.

articles.title: Runtime instances: persistent compute for production AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

articles.title: Track healthcare data lineage in real time with Amazon S3 annotations

articles.title: Analyze Amazon S3 annotations at scale with materialized views
articles.summary: AWS introduces large-scale analysis of Amazon S3 annotations using materialized views.

articles.title: Announcing: Azure Databricks Genie One and Genie Agents Free Usage Extended Through January 31, 2027
